meta.what: Circulating credit (release v16 on tracker v3.2, PROTOCOL.md 15.3 and 18): timestamp residues, the messages every operation signs (80-byte note messages M, and the 105-byte prior acknowledgments PA of tracker v3.2), quote digests, the pay statement, tracker requests with the stand-in tracker v3.2 outcome, and the decisions of the client signing firewall
meta.warning: All keys, codes, ids and tokens here are PUBLIC TEST FIXTURES from an in-memory run. None is valid on any server. Never use the test keys for anything real.

tiers.core: bytes every implementation MUST agree on (messages, signatures, canonical quote, pay statement)
tiers.circulation: client-side rules of circulating credit (residue classes, novation.quote_digest, novation.pay_statement): checked for a client that declares circulation/1 (or is required to)
tiers.consent: the client signing firewall: given the item or template and the context, sign exactly these slots or refuse with this code (normative, PROTOCOL.md 15.3); checked for a client that declares circulation/1 (or is required to)
tiers.edge: tracker-side outcomes (the stand-in tracker v3.2): informative for clients

meta.messages: messages[] and the signatures[] of transfers[]: an entry with kind prior_ack is the 105-byte prior acknowledgment PA(issuer_pubkey, recipient_pubkey, total, prior_timestamp, timestamp) of tracker v3.2; every other one is the 80-byte note message M(issuer_pubkey, recipient_pubkey, total, timestamp)
meta.decisions: consents[], payer_templates[], bound_templates[]: input (a GET /consents item, a transfer template or a bound credit-note template, as the server produced it in transcript.json, or changed to break one rule), ctx (the evaluator context: me_pk, me_id, now_ms, pins, records, signed, transfer_attempts, novated_edges, features, novation (GET /info novation: the tracker contract), deal, payee_current_pk, approved_quote_digest, consent_policy, mandate, issuer_ids, edges; verify is the Basis verifier), expected "sign" with slots (in order) and their messages (PA for a prior slot, M for a new one), or {refuse: code}; summary: fields the evaluation summary must also show

messages.name: bound-note/prior-acknowledgment-signed-by-the-creditor
messages.why: the issuer's signature does not verify under the creditor's key

messages.name: bound-note/prior-acknowledgment-v3.1
messages.why: the tracker v3.1 acknowledgment M(I,R,P,T) (80 bytes: the prior total at the note's timestamp, no prior timestamp) does not verify over PA

messages.name: transfer/from_recipient_prior-of-another-state
messages.why: the same total and T, but another prior timestamp: an acknowledgment of another state of the edge (the ABA of audit VS-1) does not verify over PA of this one

messages.name: transfer/from_recipient_prior-lifted-from-another-role
messages.why: the old creditor's signature over M(A,B,X,p), the prior state's own note message (B signs exactly it as the new creditor of a transfer, or as the creditor of a set-off, that made that state), does not verify over PA

quote_digests.name: transfer-T1
quote_digests.why: the quote bob approved for paying nina with 10 PC of alice's note

quote_digests.name: worked-example-18.3
quote_digests.why: PROTOCOL.md 18.3 worked example: base terms of canonical.json, issuer carol, deliverable sha256("example delivery")

quote_digests.name: another-payee-key
quote_digests.why: any field changed (here the payee key) gives another digest, so the owner approves exactly one destination

statements.name: pay/T1-signed-as-a-note-message
statements.why: a slot signature is over an 80-byte note message (or a 105-byte prior acknowledgment), never over the 102-byte pay statement

transfers.name: transfer/T1-as-applied
transfers.why: the seven signatures of transfer T1 (transcript), each over its slot's message (the two creditor prior slots over PA(A,R,prior,p,T) of their edges' states, the other five over M(I,R,t,T)): applied

transfers.name: transfer/standalone-raised-edge
transfers.why: the issuer's raise of the new creditor's edge, sent alone as a note: a timestamp ending in 999 belongs to transfers

tracker_outcome.error: timestamps ending in 999 ms are reserved; ordinary notes use 000-994 ms

transfers.name: transfer/missing-residue
transfers.why: every slot signed, but the timestamp does not end in 999 ms

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid transfer: a transfer timestamp ends in 999 ms

transfers.name: transfer/puppet-destination
transfers.why: the payer and a key it controls sign a destination the issuer never signed: the issuer's to-slot does not verify for it

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature (issuer_to_signature)

transfers.name: transfer/four-signature-body
transfers.why: the four-signature body of tracker versions before v3: refused (422, missing fields)

tracker_outcome.error: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: missing field `from_recipient_prior_signature`

transfers.name: transfer/five-signature-body
transfers.why: five signatures (no prior acknowledgments): refused (422), so neither creditor's current state can be skipped

tracker_outcome.error: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: missing field `from_recipient_prior_signature`

transfers.name: transfer/amplification
transfers.why: twice the amount with the signatures of the true transfer: the decrease and the increase must each be exactly what was signed

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature (issuer_from_signature)

transfers.name: transfer/colluding-payer
transfers.why: the issuer and a colluding payer sign the destination over a note they hid from the new creditor (its edge at 5): the creditor's own prior acknowledgment (of (0, 0), a new edge) does not verify for the tracker's prior state (5 at its timestamp)

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature (to_recipient_prior_signature)

transfers.name: transfer/setoff-signatures-used-as-a-transfer
transfers.why: signatures over a timestamp ending in 998 ms (a set-off) presented as a transfer: refused before any signature is checked

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid transfer: a transfer timestamp ends in 999 ms

transfers.name: transfer/too-old
transfers.why: the same body one hour and 1 ms after T: novation_expired, the maximum age (also for bound notes)

tracker_outcome.error: the novation's timestamp is older than the maximum novation age

transfers.name: transfer/unknown-field
transfers.why: a field the version-4 request does not have: refused (422, deny_unknown_fields)

tracker_outcome.error: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: unknown field `memo`

transfers.name: transfer/stale-prior-total
transfers.why: from_prior_total is not the edge's current total

tracker_outcome.error: from_prior_total, to_prior_total, from_prior_timestamp or to_prior_timestamp is not the edge's current total or timestamp

transfers.name: transfer/self-transfer
transfers.why: the old and the new creditor are the same key

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid transfer: the old and new creditor must differ

transfers.name: transfer/stale-prior-timestamp
transfers.why: from_prior_timestamp is not the timestamp of the edge's current note (diagnostic, as the totals: the signatures are what bind)

tracker_outcome.error: from_prior_total, to_prior_total, from_prior_timestamp or to_prior_timestamp is not the edge's current total or timestamp

transfers.name: transfer/v3.1-prior-acknowledgments
transfers.why: the creditors signed the tracker v3.1 acknowledgments M(A,B,X,T) and M(A,C,Y,T) (80 bytes, no prior timestamp): they do not verify over PA

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature (from_recipient_prior_signature)

transfers.name: transfer/same-total-another-state
transfers.why: audit VS-1's ABA: the held edge is back at the acknowledged total X, but in another state (a later note): PA(A,B,X,p,T) names the state it was signed on, so the old creditor's prior slot does not verify (tracker v3.1's M(A,B,X,T) did, and both attempts of a deal could apply)

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature (from_recipient_prior_signature)

setoffs.name: setoff/S2-as-applied
setoffs.why: every member signed M(I,R,P-d,ts_e) on each of its edges (per-edge timestamps ending in 998): applied

setoffs.name: setoff/unbalanced
setoffs.why: honestly signed, but one participant's decreases as creditor and as issuer differ

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid set-off: the decreases do not balance for one participant

setoffs.name: setoff/one-edge
setoffs.why: a set-off lowers at least two edges

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid set-off: a set-off lowers at least two edges

setoffs.name: setoff/residue-997
setoffs.why: every edge's timestamp must end in 998 ms

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid set-off: every edge's timestamp must end in 998 ms

setoffs.name: setoff/too-old
setoffs.why: one hour and 1 ms after an edge timestamp: novation_expired

tracker_outcome.error: the novation's timestamp is older than the maximum novation age

setoffs.name: setoff/recipient-signature-missing
setoffs.why: the creditor's slot holds the issuer's signature: every edge needs both

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid signature

setoffs.name: setoff/decrease-above-total
setoffs.why: a decrease larger than the edge's total (refused before any signature is checked)

tracker_outcome.error: Invalid set-off: a decrease exceeds the edge's total

setoffs.name: setoff/past-timestamp
setoffs.why: an edge timestamp before the edge's current note

tracker_outcome.error: timestamp must be newer than the edge's current timestamp

setoffs.name: setoff/unknown-field
setoffs.why: an edge field the version-3 request does not have (422)

tracker_outcome.error: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: unknown field `memo`

consents.name: member/sign
consents.why: a balanced set-off of her own edges: sign the new slot of each, in item order

consents.name: member/not-net-neutral
consents.why: one edge falls by 1 PC less: her claims and debts would not fall by the same amount

consents.name: member/increase-in-setoff
consents.why: a set-off only lowers edges

consents.name: member/duplicate-edge
consents.why: the same edge twice

consents.name: member/self-edge
consents.why: an edge from her key to itself

consents.name: member/not-my-edge
consents.why: an edge she is not a party to

consents.name: member/timestamp-domain
consents.why: set-off timestamps end in 998 ms

consents.name: member/bad-prior-signature
consents.why: the prior state shown is not its issuer's signature

consents.name: member/timestamp-stale
consents.why: a consent is signed only within 55 minutes of its timestamp

consents.name: member/timestamp-not-later-than-the-prior
consents.why: an edge timestamp equal to the state it changes (a novation is later than every prior shown)

consents.name: member/policy-off-local
consents.why: her local consent policy does not sign set-offs

consents.name: member/policy-off-without-a-mandate
consents.why: no mandate in the context (GET /me not read): every role is off

consents.name: member/policy-cap
consents.why: above the cap of one consent

consents.name: member/timestamp-reused
consents.why: she already signed another operation at this edge and timestamp

consents.name: member/records-unreadable
consents.why: records that cannot be read refuse everything

consents.name: member/tracker-mismatch
consents.why: another tracker than the pinned one

consents.name: member/not-collecting
consents.why: an item that is not collecting signatures is not well formed for signing

consents.name: member/pending-unbound-note
consents.why: she holds an ordinary note of hers on the edge that may still apply

consents.name: member/payment-attempt
consents.why: a bound note of hers acknowledged the total this set-off brings her edge back to: refused as a second line (on tracker v3.1 that note could then apply after it; tracker v3.2 binds its prior timestamp too)

consents.name: member/sign-without-a-tracker-contract
consents.why: a set-off signs 80-byte note messages only (no prior slot): it is signed whatever GET /info novation reports

consents.name: issuer/sign
consents.why: her debt moves from bob to nina, unchanged in total: sign both new slots, the decreased edge first

consents.name: issuer/total-owed-changes
consents.why: the raised edge rises by more than the lowered one falls

consents.name: issuer/not-my-edge
consents.why: an edge whose issuer is not her key

consents.name: issuer/sign-without-a-tracker-contract
consents.why: the issuer signs the two new slots only (80-byte note messages, no prior slot): it is signed whatever GET /info novation reports

consents.name: payee/sign
consents.why: paid for her own delivered deal by exactly its price: sign her edge's prior slot (PA of its state, (0, 0) for a new edge) and its new slot

consents.name: payee/not-delivered
consents.why: not a deal she delivered on

consents.name: payee/another-transfer
consents.why: the deal view names another transfer as its payment

consents.name: payee/issuer-refused
consents.why: her local policy refuses notes from this issuer (resolved through the directory)

consents.name: payee/policy-off-mandate
consents.why: her owner's mandate does not accept payments by transfer

consents.name: payee/prior-timestamp-not-the-state
consents.why: the item names a prior timestamp other than its edge's state (before.timestamp, 0 for a new edge): not well formed for signing

consents.name: payee/no-tracker-contract
consents.why: GET /info novation does not report the tracker v3.2 contract (here: no novation in the context): nothing that signs a prior slot is signed

consents.name: payee/tracker-v3.1-contract
consents.why: GET /info novation as a v16 server on tracker v3.1 published it (the constants only: no tracker_build, transfer_version, bound_note_version, prior_ack)

payer_templates.name: payer/sign
payer_templates.why: the three slots of the payer: the held edge's prior slot (PA of its state) and new slot, then the destination's new slot

payer_templates.name: payer/pay-with-is-payee
payer_templates.why: the note to pay with is the payee's own

payer_templates.name: payer/wrong-destination
payer_templates.why: the destination is not the payee's current directory key

payer_templates.name: payer/amount-mismatch
payer_templates.why: the amount is not the agreed price

payer_templates.name: payer/self-edge
payer_templates.why: paying with a note he issued himself

payer_templates.name: payer/timestamp-domain
payer_templates.why: a transfer timestamp ends in 999 ms

payer_templates.name: payer/bad-prior-signature
payer_templates.why: the held edge's state is not the issuer's signature

payer_templates.name: payer/timestamp-stale
payer_templates.why: what the client starts is signed only within 10 minutes of its timestamp

payer_templates.name: payer/timestamp-equal-to-the-held-state
payer_templates.why: T equal to the held edge state (it must be later than every prior shown)

payer_templates.name: payer/already-paid
payer_templates.why: his records show the deal paid

payer_templates.name: payer/attempt-outcome-unknown
payer_templates.why: an ordinary note of his for the deal may still apply at any time: only his owner can resolve it

payer_templates.name: payer/transfer-window-open
payer_templates.why: a bound note of his for the deal can still apply until its timestamp + 1 h: another kind of payment waits

payer_templates.name: payer/needs-read-back
payer_templates.why: a bound note's window has passed, but its edge was not read back: the client reads GET /edges and decides again

payer_templates.name: payer/same-prior-retry-at-another-timestamp
payer_templates.why: an earlier transfer of his through the same issuer acknowledged exactly this held state (total and timestamp) at an earlier T: both prior acknowledgments are PA of the state (X, p), which the edge has once, so at most one of the two applies; the retry is signed at once (the same-prior exemption; audit VS-1 closed by tracker v3.2)

payer_templates.name: payer/same-operation-signed-again
payer_templates.why: his earlier attempt is this very operation (the same prior state and the same T): the tracker applies at most one of the two

payer_templates.name: payer/same-total-another-prior-state
payer_templates.why: an earlier transfer of his through the same issuer acknowledged the same total in another state of the held edge (an earlier note): not the same prior state, so the retry waits for its window

payer_templates.name: payer/earlier-attempt-without-a-prior-state
payer_templates.why: an earlier transfer of his through the same issuer recorded no prior state (no prior_timestamp): never exempt, the retry waits for its window

payer_templates.name: payer/same-prior-state-another-issuer
payer_templates.why: an earlier transfer of his through another issuer's note (carol's) with the same total and timestamp: another edge, so the two do not exclude each other at the tracker, and the retry waits

payer_templates.name: payer/prior-timestamp-not-the-state
payer_templates.why: the template names a prior timestamp for the held edge other than its state's (from_edge.before.timestamp)

payer_templates.name: payer/no-tracker-contract
payer_templates.why: GET /info novation does not report the tracker v3.2 contract (here: no novation in the context): nothing that signs a prior slot is signed

payer_templates.name: payer/tracker-v3.1-contract
payer_templates.why: GET /info novation as a v16 server on tracker v3.1 published it (the constants only: no tracker_build, transfer_version, bound_note_version, prior_ack)

payer_templates.name: payer/contract-version-as-a-string
payer_templates.why: the contract's values must have the JSON types given (transfer_version 4, never '4')

payer_templates.name: payer/stale-quote
payer_templates.why: not the quote his owner approved

payer_templates.name: payer/bad-template
payer_templates.why: a template field of the wrong type

payer_templates.name: payer/deal-mismatch-without-me-id
payer_templates.why: without its own participant id the client cannot check that it is the payer: refuse

payer_templates.name: payer/policy-off-without-a-mandate
payer_templates.why: no mandate in the context: nothing is paid with a held note

payer_templates.name: payer/policy-off-never
payer_templates.why: his owner's mandate never pays with held notes

bound_templates.name: bound/sign
bound_templates.why: a bound note on the edge the transfer lowered: the prior acknowledgment (PA of the pair's note, its total and timestamp) then the note, both at the timestamp ending in 997

bound_templates.name: bound/bound-note-required
bound_templates.why: bound_notes/1 is advertised (and the edge was novated): an ordinary timestamp is refused

bound_templates.name: bound/timestamp-domain
bound_templates.why: without bound_notes/1 and on an edge not novated: a bound note ends in 997 ms

bound_templates.name: bound/amount-mismatch
bound_templates.why: the note adds more than the agreed price

bound_templates.name: bound/wrong-destination
bound_templates.why: the recipient is not the payee's current key

bound_templates.name: bound/bad-prior-signature
bound_templates.why: the prior note shown is not signed by her key

bound_templates.name: bound/deal-mismatch-without-me-id
bound_templates.why: without its own participant id the client cannot check that it is the payer: refuse

bound_templates.name: bound/transfer-window-open
bound_templates.why: a payment by transfer of hers for this deal can still apply until its timestamp + 1 h

bound_templates.name: bound/payment-attempt
bound_templates.why: a later bound note of hers for another deal acknowledged the total this note brings her edge to: refused as a second line (on tracker v3.1 that note could then apply after it; tracker v3.2 binds its prior timestamp too)

bound_templates.name: bound/same-prior-retry-at-another-timestamp
bound_templates.why: an earlier bound note of hers for this deal acknowledged the same prior state of the pair at an earlier timestamp: at most one of the two applies (only her signature moves her edge, and PA binds the state), so the retry is signed at once, as before tracker v3.2 (R-17 closed)

bound_templates.name: bound/prior-timestamp-not-the-state
bound_templates.why: the template names a prior timestamp other than its prior note's (prior_note.timestamp, 0 for none)

bound_templates.name: bound/no-tracker-contract
bound_templates.why: GET /info novation does not report the tracker v3.2 contract (here: no novation in the context): no bound note is signed (its prior acknowledgment is PA)

bound_templates.name: bound/bound-note-version-2
bound_templates.why: the contract of tracker v3.1 (bound notes version 2, acknowledged as M(I,R,P,T)): no bound note is signed

bound_templates.name: bound/sign-new-edge
bound_templates.why: the first note on an edge: prior total 0 and prior_note null; the prior acknowledgment is PA(I,R,0,0,T)
